cards.example_en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
cards.example_zh: 我们在树下休息，躲避酷热。
cards.explain_zh: heat作名词指热，hot作形容词指热的。

cards.example_en: Cities can reduce extreme heat by planting trees and replacing dark surfaces with materials that reflect sunlight.
cards.example_zh: 城市可以通过植树以及用反射阳光的材料替换深色表面来缓解酷热。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Trips to the seaside always excite my younger sister.
cards.example_zh: 去海边玩总能让我妹妹兴奋不已。
cards.explain_zh: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

cards.example_en: An eager reader, Lina always carries a book.
cards.example_zh: 莉娜热爱阅读，总是随身带着一本书。
cards.explain_zh: reader既可指人，也可指设备或供学习的读物。

cards.example_en: Losing my keys taught me the importance of a spare.
cards.example_zh: 丢了钥匙后，我才明白备用钥匙有多重要。
cards.explain_zh: importance不可数；重视某事用attach importance to。

cards.example_en: The distance from our house to school is quite short.
cards.example_zh: 从我们家到学校的距离很短。
cards.explain_zh: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

cards.example_en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
cards.example_zh: 导游带我们穿过市场里狭窄的街道。
cards.explain_zh: 指南用a guide to；指导某人完成用guide someone through。

cards.example_en: A small grant helped us repair the village playground.
cards.example_zh: 一笔小额补助金帮助我们修好了村里的游乐场。
cards.explain_zh: grant sb sth可改为grant sth to sb。

cards.example_en: We took a taxi home with our heavy bags.
cards.example_zh: 我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。
cards.explain_zh: 乘出租车可说take a taxi或by taxi。

cards.example_en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
cards.example_zh: 请在上学前喂一下猫。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为fed；feed on表示以……为食。

cards.example_en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
cards.example_zh: 我的左脚踝感到一阵剧痛。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。

cards.example_en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
cards.example_zh: 我的左脚踝感到一阵剧痛。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My sister works in the banking sector now.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐现在在银行业工作。
cards.explain_zh: sector常指经济中的某个行业，不一定是公司部门。

cards.example_en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上我误拿了你的伞。
cards.explain_zh: 说make a mistake，不说do；动词过去式为mistook。

cards.example_en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上我误拿了你的伞。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please ensure that all windows are closed before leaving.
cards.example_zh: 离开前请确保所有窗户都已关好。
cards.explain_zh: ensure接名词或that从句；insure指投保。

cards.example_en: Please ensure that all windows are closed before leaving.
cards.example_zh: 离开前请确保所有窗户都已关好。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A bowl of soup was enough to satisfy my hunger.
cards.example_zh: 一碗汤就足以让我不再饥饿。
cards.explain_zh: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。

cards.example_en: My chief concern is getting everyone home safely.
cards.example_zh: 我最关心的是让大家安全到家。
cards.explain_zh: chief可作形容词或名词；副词用chiefly。

cards.example_en: My chief concern is getting everyone home safely.
cards.example_zh: 我最关心的是让大家安全到家。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
cards.example_zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹了进来。
cards.explain_zh: cool 比 cold 温和；口语中还可表示“很酷的”。

cards.example_en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
cards.example_zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹了进来。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We asked an expert to examine the old painting.
cards.example_zh: 我们请了一位专家来鉴定这幅旧画。
cards.explain_zh: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

cards.example_en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
cards.example_zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
cards.example_zh: 一个大浪冲过了我们的小沙堡。
cards.explain_zh: 向某人挥手用wave at或wave to someone。

cards.example_en: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
cards.example_zh: 我们的阳台朝南，阳光很充足。
cards.explain_zh: 南部用in the south；向南用go south，不加to。

cards.example_en: Repairing the old fence took a full day of labor.
cards.example_zh: 修理那道旧围栏花了整整一天的工夫。
cards.explain_zh: labor为美式拼写，英式作labour。

cards.example_en: Investment in automation can reduce labor costs, but governments must help displaced workers develop new skills.
cards.example_zh: 投资自动化可以降低劳动力成本，但政府必须帮助失业工人培养新技能。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Wipe the kitchen surface before you start preparing lunch.
cards.example_zh: 开始准备午饭前，先擦一下厨房台面。
cards.explain_zh: on the surface 指“在表面上”，也可指“表面看来”。

cards.example_en: I borrowed three books from the library after school.
cards.example_zh: 放学后，我从图书馆借了三本书。
cards.explain_zh: library是借阅书籍的图书馆，bookshop是售书的书店。

cards.example_en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
cards.example_zh: 这汤好喝极了，所以我又点了一碗。
cards.explain_zh: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

cards.example_en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
cards.example_zh: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。
cards.explain_zh: 表示优势时常用an edge over，指胜过某人。

cards.example_en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
cards.example_zh: 我们在下雨前回到了营地。
cards.explain_zh: go camping表示去露营；camp也可指观点相同的阵营。

cards.example_en: The audience clapped loudly when the dancers finished.
cards.example_zh: 舞者表演结束时，观众热烈鼓掌。
cards.explain_zh: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

cards.example_en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
cards.example_zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Can you help me lift this box onto the shelf?
cards.example_zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子抬到架子上吗？
cards.explain_zh: 电梯英式用lift，美式用elevator。

cards.example_en: The receptionist explained the procedure for joining the gym.
cards.example_zh: 接待员说明了办理健身房会员的手续。
cards.explain_zh: procedure 强调规定步骤；process 更侧重整个过程。

cards.meaning_zh: 电子邮件；电子邮件通信
cards.example_en: Please email me the photos from our camping trip.
cards.example_zh: 请把我们露营旅行的照片通过电子邮件发给我。
cards.explain_zh: 指一封邮件时可数；指通信方式时不可数，如by email。

cards.example_en: Our teacher showed us a map of global temperatures.
cards.example_zh: 老师给我们看了一张全球气温分布图。
cards.explain_zh: global强调全球范围；international强调国家之间。

cards.example_en: The lesson explains the relationship between greenhouse gases and global warming.
cards.example_zh: 这节课解释温室气体与全球变暖之间的关系。

cards.example_en: Many young adults struggle to find affordable housing in cities where wages have not kept pace with rents.
cards.example_zh: 在工资涨幅赶不上房租的城市，许多年轻人很难找到负担得起的住房。
cards.explain_zh: struggle to do表示做某事很吃力，不保证成功。

cards.example_en: Governments should restrict how companies advertise sugary snacks to children, who may not recognise persuasive marketing techniques.
cards.example_zh: 政府应限制企业向儿童宣传高糖零食的方式，因为儿童可能无法识别具有诱导性的营销手法。
cards.explain_zh: advertise产品指宣传；advertise for人指登广告招聘。

cards.example_en: Please select a fresh apple from the basket.
cards.example_zh: 请从篮子里挑选一个新鲜的苹果。
cards.explain_zh: select 比 choose 正式，常强调仔细挑选。

cards.example_en: Tall trees surround the cottage and shade its windows.
cards.example_zh: 高大的树木环绕着小屋，为窗户遮阴。
cards.explain_zh: 常用be surrounded by；surroundings指周围环境。

cards.example_en: We only discovered the extent of the leak yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 我们昨天才发现漏水有多严重。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“在某种程度上”用to some extent。

cards.example_en: The new policy addresses the problem to some extent.
cards.example_zh: 新政策在某种程度上解决了这个问题。

cards.example_en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上，我们看着鸭子游过河面。
cards.explain_zh: 河名通常带the，如the River Nile。

cards.example_en: Our annual family picnic was held beside the lake.
cards.example_zh: 我们一年一度的家庭野餐在湖边举行。
cards.explain_zh: annual 表示每年的；annually 是副词，意为每年。

cards.example_en: The annual report provides useful evidence of how public funding has improved local transport services.
cards.example_zh: 年度报告提供了有用的证据，说明公共资金如何改善了当地交通服务。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Teachers should encourage students to learn from mistakes rather than feel ashamed of making them.
word.example_zh: 教师应鼓励学生从错误中学习，而不是因为犯错而感到羞愧。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Global cooperation is essential for tackling climate change because environmental damage rarely respects national borders.
word.example_zh: 全球合作对于应对气候变化至关重要，因为环境破坏很少受国界限制。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
